rq: RQ-1: How well do automated screening tools reproduce human inclusion decisions in systematic reviews?

charted.main_finding: the tool matched human recall, missing fewer than one included study in twenty

charted.study_design: prospective validation with dual human screening as reference
charted.main_finding: the tool missed roughly one in five relevant records compared with dual human screening
recall was above 0.95, consistent with the tool serving as a reliable second screener
